headline: He ramps fast, communicates well, and doesn't need a lot of oversight.
quote: I've worked with Ben on and off for five years across a wide range of projects, from competitive research and positioning to sales enablement and content strategy. No matter what I've thrown at him, he consistently delivers high-quality work and gets it right the first time. He ramps fast, communicates well, and doesn't need a lot of oversight. If you're looking for a senior product marketer who can step in and make an immediate impact, Ben is the person to call.
name: Tim Rhodes
